annotations.title: Get one paywall or onboarding flow's config

description: The configuration of one paywall or onboarding flow, plus its version history (version, note, date). A served design's compiled html is left out (html_bytes gives its size) and a Studio doc shows as doc: true; read the design with get_paywall_doc or get_onboarding_doc. Note that configs never contain price strings — prices resolve at render time from the PurchasesAdapter's packages, so never copy a price literal out of (or into) a config.
